report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Divya Krishnan | Age: 39
Body Temperature at Scene: 26.1°C | Ambient Temperature: 26.2°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 5.6 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  2. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  3. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): GHB, Carbon Monoxide, Chloroform

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
